conviction_note: Pre-revenue name trading on a business update; the event-implied move (13.8%) sets abs_move at 14, and a slight up-lean (p_up 55) comes from a ~20% short float, a -29% five-session slide with no company news, and a market value only ~1.15x June-30 tangible book, offset by an unknown post-Sept-11 ATM run-rate and capex pacing risk; findings sum +0.4 and the scaled number +1.4, the gap being that the per-finding sizes net out more symmetrically than the positioning-driven lean.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus revenue $1.02M, EPS -$0.24 (GuruFocus via Yahoo, 2026-11-05: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/earnings-watch-oklo-inc-oklo-122907330.html); MarketBeat carries the same date (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-6-oklo-inc-stock/) but the EPS figure is single-sourced. The bar the stock actually trades on is the company's own 2026 guide raised 2026-08-07: cash used in operations $120-150M, capex $400-500M (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/07/oklo-oklo-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/), plus the ATM run-rate after the 2026-09-11 $1B program and any Aurora-INL cost figure. EPS/revenue bar is single-source, so reported-quarter findings are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest ~19.3% of shares (October, GuruFocus 2026-11-03: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9167469/oklo-oklo-tops-utility-sector-short-interest-amidst-lossmaking-status-and-high-pricetosales-ratio), 18.09% at end-September (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9108027/oklo-oklo-leads-utilities-sector-in-short-interest-amid-steep-stock-decline), 21.9% of float with short ratio 3.71 days on Finviz (https://finviz.com/stock?t=OKLO&ty=si, undated); Benzinga 19.99%, 3.51 days to cover as of ~2026-10-16. Sweep row's July figure was 15.6%/1.9 days, so the short has grown into the print. Most-shorted utility above $2B (Seeking Alpha 2026-11-03). Skew_25d is null in the baseline (not available); put/call OI ratio 0.70, ATM IV 129%. Tape: -29.3% 5d, -45.2% 20d, at the 52w low, -84% from the 52w high.

findings.finding: At the sealed spot of $18.95 OKLO's market value (~186M shares at Aug-4 plus ~7.3M ATM shares sold Jul-Sep 10, so ~193M+ shares, ~$3.7B) sits barely above its June-30 cash and marketable securities of $3,006.3M and its June-30 net tangible book value of $3.2B / $17.34 per share; with ~$320M of Q3 ATM proceeds against roughly $150-190M of quarterly opex+capex burn, Sept-30 liquidity should print around $3.1-3.2B, i.e. ~$16 of cash per share against an $18.95 stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (2026-05-12 amc): $2.5B cash did not offset a wider loss, stock about -6%; Q2 2026 (2026-08-07): $3.0B liquidity plus Groves criticality, stock +14.8% on the day (GuruFocus/Yahoo). Balance-sheet line has not on its own moved the stock.
findings.source_date: 2026-08 (10-Q for quarter ended 2026-06-30; cover count as of 2026-08-04)
findings.why_not_priced: It is public arithmetic, so partly priced; but the stock has fallen ~15% in two sessions on sector flows (midterms) with no company news, and a stock pricing in a cash-shell floor would not be making new lows on the day before a print that will restate ~$3.1B of liquidity. If the market were anchored on cash, the 5-day slide would have stalled near tangible book.
findings.independence: TIKR 2026-11-05 computes market value ≥$3.8B at ~$20 against $3.0B June cash (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sank-10-a-day-after-the-democratic-sweep-rattled-ai-power-stocks-heres-what-fridays-report-has-to-settle); NTBV $17.34/share from the 424B5 of 2026-09-11 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001849056/000110465926106909/tm2625056-3_424b5.htm). Shares the 10-Q document with the ATM finding.

findings.finding: Short interest has risen from ~15.6% of float in July to ~19-22% of float in October with 3.5-3.7 days to cover, into a -29% five-session decline that TIKR says had no company-specific news; a benign business update into that position is a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 print rallied +14.8% in one day from a depressed tape; no measured squeeze history on this name otherwise.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is visible, so the position itself is known; what is not priced is the asymmetry of a crowded short at the 52w low into a release that is a narrative update with no hard numbers to miss. If squeeze risk were priced, the put/call OI would be skewed to calls and the stock would not be making lows into the event.
findings.independence: Finviz 21.9% float / 3.71 short ratio (https://finviz.com/stock?t=OKLO&ty=si); WallStreetBuys 21.9%, +1.4pp m/m (https://wallstreetbuys.com/stocks/oklo.us); TIKR on no company news (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sinks-6-comfort-systems-usa-down-15-as-democratic-sweep-rattles-ai-power-stocks-a-negative-surprise).

findings.finding: Oklo opened a new $1.0B ATM on 2026-09-11 (10 agents, up to 1.5% commission) after selling ~18M shares for ~$1.0B under the May program, including ~7.3M shares (~$320M, ~$44/share) in Q3 through Sept 10; the Q3 release/10-Q will show how much was sold after Sept 11 as the stock fell from ~$42 to the $20s, and analysts have named 'light stock sales after Sept 11' as one of the three things Friday must show.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not isolated on a print; share count +34% in 18 months while the stock fell, ATM average price fell from $96.95 (January) to $63.51 (Q2) to ~$44 (Q3 to Sept 10).
findings.why_not_priced: The program is public; its usage since Sept 11 is not, and will be disclosed only in the Q3 10-Q / subsequent-events note. Financing question asked: the money funds Aurora-INL capex, fuel and the Ohio/Meta campus, with no revenue ramp to corroborate it, but June liquidity alone covers burn through 2028 and there is no going-concern language, so this is dilution-at-lower-prices rather than distress, hence small.
findings.independence: TIKR 2026-11-05 lists ATM run-rate as a test for the print (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sank-10-a-day-after-the-democratic-sweep-rattled-ai-power-stocks-heres-what-fridays-report-has-to-settle). Shares the 10-Q/424B5 documents with finding 1.

findings.finding: To hit the raised 2026 capex guide of $400-500M, Oklo needs $273-373M in H2 (≥$137M a quarter) against $126.9M spent in H1 and $94.1M in Q2; a capex shortfall or guide trim would be read as Aurora-INL timing risk against the reiterated 2028 go-live, a guide held at pace as execution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 raised both opex-cash and capex guides and the stock rose +14.8% the day of the release (the raise was framed as project acceleration).
findings.why_not_priced: The pacing arithmetic is not in the wire previews' consensus (which carries only revenue/EPS); if the market were pricing a slip, sell-side targets would be cut on schedule rather than on cost per kW. Sign is genuinely two-sided (a lower capex guide also preserves cash), so sized small.
findings.independence: Guide itself: Q2 call, CFO, 2026-08-07 (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/07/oklo-oklo-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/) and TradingView/Zacks (https://www.tradingview.com/news/zacks:65bd88c54094b:0-oklo-q2-earnings-call-links-higher-cash-use-to-execution/).

findings.finding: On the Q2 call the CFO said the Aurora-INL cost estimate with Kiewit would be narrowed 'through the rest of this year' and a tighter figure given to the market; Piper Sandler on 2026-10-19 already raised its plant cost assumption from $4,000 to $7,000/kW and cut its target $55 to $49, and expects fuller cost guidance only at a spring-2027 capital markets day, so the bar for a cost disclosure on Friday is set pessimistically and a number at or under ~$7,000/kW would be relief, a number above it a fresh negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior cost disclosure on this name; the target cuts (Piper 10-19, B. Riley $92->$61 10-28, Wedbush $110->$36 11-02/03) coincided with the 45% 20-day slide.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether Oklo gives the figure on this call is unknown; the most cited analyst expects it in spring 2027, so most holders are not positioned for a disclosure now. Low probability of disclosure keeps the expected value near zero with a wide band.
findings.independence: Management promise: Q2 transcript (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/07/oklo-oklo-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/); B. Riley cut and 'a first cost for Aurora-INL would change the outlook' (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-target-cut).

findings.finding: AI-power names sold off after the 2026-11-03 midterms projected a Democratic Congress and Texas elected a governor campaigning on a stricter data-center moratorium; OKLO fell 6% on 11-04 and ~10% intraday on 11-05 with no company news, and its ~14 GW pipeline is mostly data-center customers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sector flow, not a print line; the name has tracked NuScale nearly tick for tick in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced (the move already happened); filed because continued sector de-risking can dominate a narrative print. Macro-to-company transmission is not confirmed by the company or a counterparty, so it is a proxy and sized small.
findings.independence: MarketBeat 2026-11-05 reports OKLO down $3.12 to $19.00 near the $18.53 52w low (https://marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/list-nuclear-stocks-to-watch-today-november-5th-2026-11-05).

findings.finding: Insiders filed 13 Form 144s and 25 Form 4s between 2026-09-10 and 2026-11-04, including the General Counsel's sale on 2026-11-03 days before the print, with no insider buying over 12 months.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to insider sales on this name; the sales are visible on EDGAR.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and probably 10b5-1, so mostly priced; filed small because a sale this close to the print by the general counsel is what a reader of the release will cite if the update disappoints.

findings.finding: Q3 EPS should land near the -$0.24 bar: H1 operating loss was $124.2M and net loss $81.6M with ~$30M a quarter of interest income on $3B, so a Q3 operating loss of ~$70M less interest on ~193M shares gives roughly -$0.20 to -$0.25; revenue near the $1.02M consensus after $1.21M in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EPS -$0.28 missed -$0.16 by 78% and the stock still rose +14.8%; Q1 2026 a wider net loss came with ~-6%. EPS has not been the line this stock trades on.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing unpriced here; filed as the reported-quarter read so print_vs_bar is explicit. The bar is single-sourced, so capped.

baseline_tension: No skew is available; the tape (-29% in 5 sessions, 52w low) and rising short interest argue for a capitulation into the print, so a mild up-lean cuts against the run-up momentum but agrees with positioning; p_up kept at 55 because the up-case rests on positioning and arithmetic rather than an unseen company number.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5/7: the short-interest finding rests on positioning plus an unexplained slide; trimmed +1.5 to +1.0 because an unexplained drawdown is not itself evidence.
Lesson 4: asked what the ATM buys (Aurora-INL capex, fuel, Ohio campus; liquidity covers burn through 2028, no going concern) - dilution not distress, so ATM finding shrunk -1.0 to -0.8.
Lesson 8 / untrustworthy history: rebuilt reaction base from releases (-6.4, ~-6, +14.8); abs_move left at the 14% option-implied scale.
Lessons 1, 2, 6 left the rest standing: EPS bar single-sourced so the reported-quarter EPS finding stays at 0; no findings outside the window in the list.
